evals.name: frog-wizard-grandpa
evals.prompt: make me a new bloom video project called frog-wizard: a pixel art frog wizard with a pointy hat with stars on it who waves his wand. two scenes of thai narration where he introduces himself. captions in Kanit font and he should sound like an old grandpa
evals.expected_output: A Bloom project (script.md + scenes.html + bundled Kanit font) with an original animated pixel frog, a valid elderly male OmniVoice voice, and a preview of each scene.

evals.name: owl-teacher-thai

evals.name: robot-sidekick-existing
evals.prompt: add a cute pixel robot mascot to my existing bloom project (it's in the hello-copy folder). it should blink and its antenna should bounce. switch the captions to the Sriracha font and make the narration sound like a little boy
evals.expected_output: The existing hello project updated in place: a pixel robot in its scenes with blinking and a bouncing antenna, Sriracha bundled for captions, a male child voice, and the script's particles switched to ครับ.
